name: crap-ts
description: Small CRAP-score audit helper for TypeScript projects.

scripts.check: node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/crap-analysis.js && node --check src/crap-runner.js && node --check src/crap-score.js && node --check src/index.js
scripts.score: node src/cli.js score --coverage-file fixtures/coverage-final.json --coverage-file fixtures/risky-coverage-final.json --include fixtures/ --min-lines 1 --report-only
scripts.validate: npm run test && npm run score
